8 sample questions, worked out

Straight from the test, with the answer and the reasoning shown. The full test gives you 110 of these, drawn fresh each time.

  1. Question 1 A 0.5 MGD system needs a 6.0 mg/L dose. The hypochlorite on hand is 12.5 percent available chlorine. How many pounds of hypochlorite solution per day?

    1. A. 25 lb/day
    2. B. 200 lb/day Correct answer
    3. C. 320 lb/day
    4. D. 100 lb/day

    Why Pure chlorine: 0.5 x 6.0 x 8.34 = 25 lb/day. The product is only 12.5 percent chlorine, so 25 / 0.125 = 200 lb of solution per day.

    Formula lb product = (MGD x mg/L x 8.34) / strength

    Dosage 8.34 · Hard · Application

  2. Question 2 A pump delivers 350 gpm. What is this flow expressed in MGD?

    1. A. 0.50 MGD Correct answer
    2. B. 0.35 MGD
    3. C. 5.04 MGD
    4. D. 0.24 MGD

    Why 350 gpm x 1440 min/day = 504,000 gpd. 504,000 / 1,000,000 = 0.50 MGD.

    Formula MGD = gpm x 1440 / 1,000,000

    Units conversions · Easy · Application

  3. Question 3 A gravity thickener 30 ft in diameter receives 60,000 gpd of sludge at 8,000 mg/L solids. What is the solids loading in pounds per day per square foot?

    1. A. 2.8 lb/day/sq ft
    2. B. 11.3 lb/day/sq ft
    3. C. 0.6 lb/day/sq ft
    4. D. 5.7 lb/day/sq ft Correct answer

    Why Solids: 0.06 MGD x 8,000 x 8.34 = about 4,000 lb/day. Area: 0.785 x 30 x 30 = 706 sq ft. Loading = 4,000 / 706 = about 5.7.

    Formula loading = (MGD x mg/L x 8.34) / area

    Loading rates · Hard · Application

  4. Question 4 A 12-inch line flows full at 3.0 ft/s. About what flow is that in gpm?

    1. A. 530 gpm
    2. B. 2,120 gpm
    3. C. 106 gpm
    4. D. 1,060 gpm Correct answer

    Why A 12-inch pipe has an area of 0.785 x 1 x 1 = 0.785 sq ft. Q = 0.785 x 3.0 = 2.36 cfs, and 2.36 x 448.8 = about 1,060 gpm.

    Formula gpm = A x V x 448.8

    Flow velocity · Medium · Application

  5. Question 5 A sedimentation basin is 80 ft long, 30 ft wide, and 12 ft deep, and treats 2.0 MGD. What is the detention time in hours?

    1. A. 1.3 hours
    2. B. 5.2 hours
    3. C. 2.6 hours Correct answer
    4. D. 0.6 hours

    Why Volume is 80 x 30 x 12 x 7.48 = about 215,400 gallons. Flow is 2,000,000 / 24 = 83,333 gallons per hour. 215,400 / 83,333 = about 2.6 hours.

    Formula DT = (L x W x D x 7.48) / (gpd / 24)

    Detention time · Medium · Application

  6. Question 6 What does the 3,960 in the water horsepower formula do?

    1. A. Accounts for motor efficiency
    2. B. Converts psi into feet
    3. C. Converts gpm times feet of head into horsepower Correct answer
    4. D. Accounts for the weight of chlorine

    Why It is the unit conversion: 33,000 ft-lb per minute per horsepower divided by 8.34 lb per gallon gives 3,960. Flow times head divided by it yields horsepower.

    Formula whp = gpm x ft / 3960

    Pumping hp · Easy · Recall

  7. Question 7 How many gallons are contained in 1,000 ft of 8-inch diameter pipe?

    1. A. 2,610 gal Correct answer
    2. B. 349 gal
    3. C. 31,300 gal
    4. D. 5,230 gal

    Why 8 in = 0.667 ft. Area = 0.785 x 0.667 x 0.667 = 0.349 sq ft. Volume = 0.349 x 1,000 = 349 cu ft. 349 x 7.48 = 2,610 gallons.

    Formula gallons = 0.785 x diameter squared x length x 7.48 (convert inches to feet first)

    Volume · Medium · Analysis

  8. Question 8 A pressure gauge at the base of a standpipe reads 26 psi. How high is the water above the gauge?

    1. A. 26 ft
    2. B. 60 ft Correct answer
    3. C. 11 ft
    4. D. 120 ft

    Why Each psi supports 2.31 feet of water: 26 x 2.31 = about 60 feet.

    Formula head (ft) = psi x 2.31

    Pressure head · Easy · Application
